what: Deep-network Laplacian per call on JAX, one CPU thread, float64: omnibias planned default (forward: differentiate none; value-and-gradient: differentiate params, split stream layout) against folx (dense and sparse), jax.experimental.jet and nested autodiff (17 cells of the per-call grid)
hardware: one thread of a farm CPU host, JAX 0.10.2 (XLA:CPU), one fresh process per round, 3 rounds
protocol: f64: 3 fresh-process rounds of the 40-cell per-call grid; the omnibias program and every baseline are timed in the same process of a round (host-timed call: median of repeated blocks; device: mean of 32 back-to-back calls with one synchronisation, a CUDA-graph replay on PyTorch); ratio = baseline time / omnibias time, median over rounds, 95 % hierarchical bootstrap interval over rounds
